content:
(Voice trembling, a little shaky, but with an edge of forced calm)

"Hey... can we talk? I know things have been weird, and I've been distant, and I just... I need you to understand. You're making things harder than they need to be, and I'm really struggling here.

You've been acting so strange lately, you know? So suspicious. It's like you're looking for something to be wrong, like you *want* there to be a problem. Is that it? Are you just unhappy with us and looking for a reason to blame me for everything? Because that’s not fair.

I’ve been feeling so alone, and you haven't been paying attention. You're always so caught up in your own head, your own worries. I try to talk to you, and you just brush me off or get defensive. It’s like I’m invisible sometimes. It’s really hard to feel connected when you’re just… not there.

And all these accusations! It’s like you’re creating scenarios that don’t even exist. Are you sure you're not just… seeing things? Misunderstanding things? Sometimes when you’re anxious, you can really blow things out of proportion. I don’t want to say you’re imagining things, but… are you sure you’re remembering everything correctly?

I’ve been under so much stress lately. Work, my family, everything. And I feel like I can’t even come to you for comfort anymore. You’re making me feel like a criminal just for trying to find some simple human connection.

It hurts me when you say these things. It really does. It makes me feel like you don’t trust me at all. Do you even love me? Because if you did, you wouldn't be interrogating me like this. You wouldn't be building up all these walls between us.

I'm trying my best here. I really am. I love you, and I want this to work. But you have to stop this. You have to stop making me feel like I'm the bad guy. It's exhausting. Can we please just… try to move past this and focus on what’s good between us? Because right now, you're the one pushing me away."
